Create a progress bar UI component showing 70% completion: a 400x32 light-gray background bar (id=progress_bg), a 280x32 green fill bar (id=progress_fill, style fill:#4caf50), and a centered white text label '70%' inside the fill (id=progress_label).

Create a vertical bar chart titled '部门季度销售额' with 4 bars and labeled axes: 销售部(id=bar_sales, height=160, fill=#2196f3), 市场部(id=bar_marketing, height=120, fill=#ff9800), 工程部(id=bar_engineering, height=190, fill=#4caf50), 支持部(id=bar_support, height=90, fill=#f44336). Each bar has a centered text label below with the department name. Add a chart title text element (id=chart_title) at the top.

Create a user avatar component for user 'Alex': a 100px-radius circle background (id=avatar_bg, fill=#3f51b5), a centered white letter 'A' in 64px bold font (id=avatar_initial, text='A'), and a thin 4px-stroke border ring (id=avatar_ring, r=108, fill=none, stroke=#3f51b5). Center everything at (400, 300).

Create a horizontal button group with 3 labeled buttons: '确认' (id=btn_confirm, fill=#1976d2), '保存' (id=btn_save, fill=#388e3c), '取消' (id=btn_cancel, fill=#d32f2f). Each button is 140x44px with rx=8, white text centered inside. Buttons start at x=80, y=278, spaced 160px apart.

Create a realistic traffic light graphic: a dark gray (#37474f) rounded rectangle frame (id=traffic_frame, 80x230, rx=16) at (360,80), 3 circular lights stacked vertically — red (id=light_red, fill=#f44336), yellow (id=light_yellow, fill=#ffeb3b), green (id=light_green, fill=#4caf50) — each with r=25, cx=400, spaced 76px apart starting at cy=148. Add a 'STOP' text label (id=stop_label) below in red when light_red is active.

Create a color palette panel titled '品牌色板': 5 square color swatches (60x60, rx=6) in a row at y=240, spaced 90px apart starting at x=80: id=swatch_red(#f44336), swatch_blue(#2196f3), swatch_green(#4caf50), swatch_orange(#ff9800), swatch_purple(#9c27b0). Below each swatch, a hex-code text label (id=swatch_label_red etc.). Above the swatches, a title text (id=palette_title, text='品牌色板').

Design a professional website navigation bar (800x60) for company '启明科技': full-width dark background rect (id=nav_bg, fill=#1a237e, height=60), company logo text '启明科技' on the left (id=nav_logo, x=24, fill=#ffffff, bold), and 4 navigation links at right: '首页'(id=nav_home,x=520), '产品'(id=nav_products,x=600), '关于我们'(id=nav_about,x=670), '联系'(id=nav_contact,x=760), all fill=#b0bec5, font-size=14px. Add a 3px bottom accent line (id=nav_accent, fill=#00e5ff).

Create a labeled pie chart titled '2024年销售区域分布' with 4 sectors using SVG path arcs centered at (400,310), r=130: 华东 38% (id=pie_east, fill=#2196f3), 华南 27% (id=pie_south, fill=#ff9800), 华北 22% (id=pie_north, fill=#4caf50), 西部 13% (id=pie_west, fill=#f44336). Add a text label near each sector showing region name and percentage. Add chart title (id=chart_title, y=50). Add a legend group (id=legend) with 4 color squares + text at bottom.

Create a professional 3-step horizontal process flowchart titled '产品研发流程': Step 1 box '需求分析' (id=flow_box_1, blue border, fill=#e3f2fd), arrow (id=flow_arrow_1), Step 2 box '设计开发' (id=flow_box_2, orange border, fill=#fff3e0), arrow (id=flow_arrow_2), Step 3 box '测试上线' (id=flow_box_3, green border, fill=#e8f5e9). Each box has centered text with the step name (id=flow_text_1/2/3). Add a title (id=flow_title) and step number labels '① ② ③' above each box.

Design a complete professional business card (600x340) for: Name: 张伟 (Zhang Wei), Title: 产品总监, Company: 启明科技有限公司, Phone: +86 138-0013-8000, Email: zhang.wei@qiming.com, Website: www.qiming.com. Layout: white card background with subtle shadow, company logo circle (id=card_logo, fill=#1a237e) with '启' text on left, name in large bold (id=card_name, text='张伟'), title below (id=card_title, text='产品总监'), company name (id=card_company, text='启明科技有限公司'), horizontal divider line (id=card_divider), phone (id=card_phone, text='+86 138-0013-8000'), email (id=card_email, text='zhang.wei@qiming.com'), website (id=card_website, text='www.qiming.com').
